title: Conditional κ = 0.001672167430672016: improved T16 owner packing on the seven-slot k8 word
body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.001672167430672016**, +7.6×10⁻¹⁰ over #1028 (0.001672166670891177). Same construction and code as #1022/#1028; only the T16 owner map changes (exact LNS repack). Differs from #1028 only in `data/{OWNERS,PLAN,SPEC}`, README, RESULT and MANIFEST.

## Verification

From a fresh clone of e900534f (Windows, CPython 3.11.11): `verify_manifest.py` PASS, then `verify_t16.py --local <#1018 verify_slots.py work/local>` in 30 s:
`PASS_GAUGE44_T16_STRICT_GLOBAL_REPLAY 0.001672167430672016`

Credits as in #1022. Prepared with oh-my-pi using Claude Opus 5.5.
